sloka: ऐङ्गुदं बदरीमिश्रं पिण्याकं दर्भसंस्तरे ।न्यस्य राम: सुदु:खार्त्तो रुदन् वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ २.१०२.२९॥
transliteration: aiṅgudaṁ badarīmiśraṁ piṇyākaṁ darbhasaṁstare ।nyasya rāma: sudu:khārtto rudan vacanamabravīt ॥ 2.102.29॥

translations.english: Placing the balls of ingudi pulp mixed with badari fruit on a spread of darbha grass, Rama, was overcome with grief and weeping, said:
